standard_prerequisites.name: Theorem: for a separated morphism of finite presentation of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes and a Noetherian ring Lambda, Rf_! sends D^+_{tors, c} (or D_c if Lambda is torsion) into D^+_{tors, c}(Y) (or D_c(Y)), i.e. Rf_!K has constructible cohomology sheaves (more-etale, Theorem theorem-constructible-shriek, canonical tag 0GL0)
standard_prerequisites.use: The named theorem giving constructibility of Rf_!K, of which the finiteness of H^i_c is stated to be an immediate consequence.

standard_prerequisites.name: Section defining compactly supported cohomology (more-etale, Section section-compactly-supported-cohomology, canonical tag 0GJY)
standard_prerequisites.use: The definition of the compactly supported cohomology groups H^i_c(X, K) whose finiteness is being proven.

core_obligations: Immediate consequence: H^i_c(X, K) is computed from Rf_!K for a proper compactification via the definition in section-compactly-supported-cohomology (tag 0GJY), and theorem-constructible-shriek (tag 0GL0) gives that Rf_!K has constructible cohomology, hence finite stalks over the algebraically closed base point, so H^i_c(X, K) is a finite Lambda-module (proof lines 4996-5000).
proof_roadmap: Invoke the constructible shriek theorem for Rf_!K (proof lines 4996-4997).
Read off finiteness of H^i_c(X, K) from the definition of compactly supported cohomology in the named section (proof lines 4997-4999).
